resources.string: Revisit the introduction, setup, and try-it screens.
Turn speech into text, right on your phone. For messages, ideas, and everything worth keeping.
No account. No subscription. Just your words.
Meet you at the usual place.
Speak naturally. Utterlane turns speech into text on your phone.
the pace of phone typing\nin these studies

36.2 WPM · mobile typing. Palin et al. (MobileHCI 2019): 37,370 volunteers copied English sentences on mobile devices. A typing word is five characters.

164 WPM · natural conversation. Yuan, Liberman & Cieri (Interspeech 2006): turn-wise rate in English telephone conversations. This measures human speech, not voice typing.

164 ÷ 36.2 ≈ 4.5. Different studies and counting methods; this is not a guaranteed personal speed gain or an Utterlane benchmark. App speed and accuracy vary with model, device, and audio.

Our default for phones with more memory. A larger download, with less quantization.
Ultra in a smaller package. Lower precision in exchange for a lighter model.
Native ternary model for limited memory. Prioritizes size; speed and accuracy can vary.
Original NVIDIA model with the ONNX engine. A familiar baseline, with a larger footprint.
